page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top left. No marginal notes. Watermark at bottom right excluded.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: um ordine & sapientiâ valida in societa-tem judiciorum adscita contumaciæ po-tentum terrori, & fluctuanti jurisdictio-ni firmamento ac subsidio erat. Nec e-nim tum quoque æquabilis in jure dicun-do ratio in subselliis prætorum perAgrum ubique servabatur, & qui opibus vale-bant in nobiliate, non facile se legum scitis & judicum sententiis suæ cupidini adversis subiiciebant: Unde mala me-tuebantur, quæ affligendæ patriæ, & e-vertendæ libertati poterant esse. Quæ cùm priori more vix jam reprimi posse videbantur, remedio majore opus esse sapientes in provinciâ, ac patriæ & pa-cis amantes judicarunt. Itaque omnes omninò inter Amasum & Lavicam, qui potestatis publicæ partem tenebant, quos seorsim per minores populos in oppido coire, & cum oppidanis sententias judi-cum recognoscere mos ferè ferebat, si-mul Groningæ adesse jussi sunt, cùm annus ageretur à Christo in terris nato M. CCC. LXVIII, Ibi consensu omnium decretum solenniter, ut bis quotannis judices, qui inter Amasum & Lavicam flumina

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "perAgrum" is printed without a visible space and may be two words (per Agrum); transcribed as printed. "nobiliate" and "populos" are as printed. The year "LXVIII" in small capitals is read as LXVIII (1368), with some uncertainty. The final line "flumina" is set right-aligned in italics; it is read as the last text line, but it could be a catchword for the next page, which is not visible. u/v corrected in "Unde" (vowel). Long s rendered as plain s throughout, including in the running head.
